fall_protection.context: Primary fall protection duty for construction

hot_work.context: Fire prevention and hot work permits

guardrails.recommendation: Install guardrail systems meeting OSHA specifications
specificRequirements: Top edge height of 42 inches (+/- 3 inches)
Mid-rail at approximately 21 inches
Withstand 200 lbs outward or downward force
Toeboard when material/tools could fall on workers below

pfas.recommendation: Implement personal fall arrest system with proper anchorage
specificRequirements: Anchor points capable of supporting 5,000 lbs per employee
Full body harness (body belts prohibited for fall arrest)
Maximum arresting force of 1,800 lbs on employee
Limit free fall to 6 feet

arc_flash_program.recommendation: Conduct arc flash risk assessment and implement controls
specificRequirements: Determine if arc flash hazard exists
Calculate incident energy or use PPE category tables
Install arc flash labels on equipment
Select appropriate arc-rated PPE
Written energy control procedures for each equipment type
Authorized employee training and documentation
Individual lockout devices for each worker
Annual procedure inspection and certification

eewp.recommendation: Implement energized electrical work permit process
specificRequirements: Documented justification for energized work
Hazard analysis completed
PPE and approach boundaries specified
Approval by qualified person
